text: All armed prophets have conquered, and the unarmed ones have been destroyed. Besides the reasons mentioned, the nature of the people is variable, and whilst it is easy to persuade them, it is difficult to fix them in that persuasion.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter VI, Concerning new principalities which are acquired by one's own arms and ability
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
